Public Engineering Log • Signed Universal x64 & Native ARM64

Version History & Release Notes

Follow every milestone of RaggieSoft Installer Studio as it evolves in public as original, zero-dependency native Win32 C++20 software.

Download Latest v0.5.0 (Auto-Detects CPU) Full Offline Installer (x64 + ARM64 in One EXE) Inspect v0.5.0 Screenshots Read FAQ
Latest Release • November 2026

v0.5.0 — 10 Selectable Wizard Styles, Classic & Custom Setup Types, Billboards & WCAG Auto-Contrast

  • 10 Selectable First-Party Wizard Styles ([UI] WizardLayout): Shipped standard, wizard95 (#C0C0C0 3D beveled sheet + 164px sunken left graphic rail across every page), wizard97, aerowizard, fluentmica, oneclick, passivetoast, fullscreenblue, fullscreenteal (1995 #008080 ACME callback), and autorun16x9—all yielding automatically to SPI_GETHIGHCONTRAST.
  • Classic Windows 95 & Author-Defined Setup Types + [Billboard.*]: Added 4-card win95_classic Setup Types (Typical, Compact, Complete, Custom), repeatable [SetupType.<Id>] cards, floating 3D [Billboard.<Id>] showcase cards, and expanded MSI.DLL ActionData file/byte progress formatting.
  • Live WCAG 2.2 AA Brand Contrast Enforcer (RswWcagContrast.hpp & RSW055): Added W3C relative luminance validation in instbuild.exe --validate plus a one-click Auto-Fix WCAG button in InstallerStudio.exe.
Milestone • November 2026

v0.4.5 — Microsoft Azure Artifact Signing, ARM64 /dlib Dispatch & Pre-Signed Template Safety

  • 100% Cryptographically Signed Release via Microsoft Azure Artifact Signing: Dual-Layer Public Trust Authenticode signing with RFC 3161 SHA-256 timestamps across all inner C++20 executables, x64/ARM64 .msi databases, and Universal outer Setup.exe launchers.
  • Architecture-Aware /dlib SignTool Dispatch & Local Temp Resource Stamping: Automatic PE Machine matching for Azure.CodeSigning.Dlib.dll on Windows 11 ARM64 plus clean ImageRemoveCertificate stripping.
Milestone • November 2026

v0.4.4 — Plain-English Feature Inclusion Tiers & Public FAQ

  • Replaced raw numeric InstallLevel inputs with human-friendly Included In tiers (minimal, typical, complete, hidden) and launched the public FAQ.
Milestone • November 2026

v0.4.3 — CPU-Aware Smart Web Stub & Combined Offline Universal Single-EXE (x64 + ARM64)

  • Added IsWow64Process2 Prism-piercing Smart Web Stubs and Combined Offline Universal EXEs with build-stamped SHA-256 verification.
Milestones • November 2026

v0.4.0 – v0.4.2 — 12-View Tree-First IDE, Dark-Mode Push Buttons & Native C++20 Help

  • Shipped 32-bit ARGB vector SysTreeView32 hierarchies, dedicated Features & RegEdit Registry trees, sub-16ms live Dark ↔ Light palette hot-swapping, and zero-dependency RaggieSoftHelp.exe.
Initial Milestones • November 2026

v0.1.0 – v0.3.0 — Static /MT C++20 Foundation, Component Rules, LZMS, Pre-MSI Runtimes & .MSM

  • Established the static /MT C++20 compiler, deterministic UUIDv5 GUIDs, ICE18/38/64/80 validation, Windows LZMS compression, Pre-MSI [Prerequisite.*] broker, 64-bit .MSM merger, and SelectionTree.
